Package de.tum.cit.ase.bomberquest.map

Class CollisionCategories

java.lang.Object
de.tum.cit.ase.bomberquest.map.CollisionCategories
public class CollisionCategories extends Object
The CollisionCategories class defines collision category bits and their corresponding collision masks for the BomberQuest game. These are used to specify which game objects can collide with each other during the game's physics simulation.

The collision categories and masks help in controlling how different entities in the game (e.g., player, walls, enemies, bombs, explosions, and power-ups) interact with one another. Each category is assigned a unique bit, and masks determine the interaction rules.

Usage

These categories and masks are used in the game's physics engine to filter collisions and ensure that interactions are handled correctly.
